articles.summary: NCR Atleos Corporation (NYSE: NATL) (“Atleos”), a leader in expanding self-service financial access for financial institutions, retailers and consumers, today announced AllTM, an ATM solution that helps US retailers transform the ATM from a traditional cash access point into a powerful driver of foot traffic, customer engagement and revenue growth through expanded capabilities.
articles.title: NCR Atleos introduces AllTM, an ATM solution designed for retailers, aimed at driving traffic, revenue and customer engagement
